requirements.novelty: Standalone new-problem novelty not supported. Current candidate is a conditional empirical extension; low correlation, chronology, adding a frozen model or standard variance decomposition are insufficient contributions.
requirements.data_for_full_question: 153 full processed/native label sequences yield unique mappings for all 51 people; processed numbering is chronological. All native-event/converted-signal header dates agree; 9 two-date people excluded. Waveform checks limited to subject 1 first trials. Full signal/training protocol acceptance remains incomplete. Author preprocessing example filters continuous data before epoching; current upstream defaults noncausal. Processed MAT alone cannot establish strict decision-time information access; offline and strict-prefix claims must be separated.
requirements.minimal_discriminating_validation: Defined prospective incremental value of same-person early comparison information versus population information, holding real fitting history fixed. Standard controls alone are not novelty.
requirements.feasibility_precision: Completed 28 standardized MDE scenarios under a frozen-policy iid-normal paired-user reference model, independently checked across two SciPy versions, numerical integration and simulations. n=42 primary alpha=.05 power=.8 MDE=.443 sigma; not a validated power guarantee for the future EEG experiment. Practical threshold remains unspecified.
